articles.title: FIFA president Infantino ‘must go’, says former UEFA boss Platini
articles.summary: In a scathing interview, French great Michel Platini accuses Infantino of always loving ‘money and power’.
articles.body:
French football great Michel Platini says FIFA president Gianni Infantino “must go” following the scandals that have surrounded football’s governing body and rocked the sport globally.

“Economic affairs are one thing, but Infantino has failed because he is the guarantor of the rules of the game and he didn’t respect them,” former UEFA president Platini told a French media outlet on Sunday.

The 56-year-old Infantino has been under fire since his aborted plan to bring private investment into FIFA events, such as the World Cup. He was also lambasted over a number of controversies during the recently concluded World Cup in North America.

Platini hit out at the so-called hydration breaks at the World Cup, which often lasted as much as four minutes and were used by the host broadcaster for advertisements.

He also pointed to the half-time show during the final, which largely overran the required maximum of 15 minutes, and the furore around FIFA suspending the red card ban given to American forward Folarin Balogun following a phone call made by United States President Donald Trump to Infantino.

“The ad breaks are not in the rules, the 30-minute half-time break in the final is not in the rules, and the red card, that’s the worst,” said Platini.

“He’s the guarantor [of the rules], he doesn’t respect them, he must go,” added Platini, who was UEFA’s secretary-general under the Frenchman’s leadership.

Since the World Cup, UEFA threatened to boycott FIFA tournaments until Infantino scrapped the FIFA Forward Enterprises plan to bring in private investment.

European football’s governing body UEFA has also accused Infantino of “criminal mismanagement” over the private financing.

FIFA did not respond to Al Jazeera’s request for a comment.

Other regional bodies – the Confederation of North, Central America and Caribbean Association Football (CONCACAF) and the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) – have joined UEFA in putting pressure on Infantino, who is hoping to run for re-election in March.

“It won’t be sporting institutions that sort this out and bring him down,” Platini said.

“If UEFA want to bring down Infantino, it will be through the courts.”

“I always knew that he loved money and power,” Platini added about the Swiss-Italian.

Platini was himself accused of fraud in 2015 when he was UEFA president and eyeing the top job at FIFA to replace Sepp Blatter, who was likewise accused of giving an illegal payment of $2m to the Frenchman.

Platini was eventually acquitted of any wrongdoing in 2025 but was forced to step down at the time, with Infantino leaping on the opportunity to be elected FIFA president in his stead in 2016.

“He didn’t bring me down, he benefitted from it,” said Platini.

“But now that there are lots of investigations into him all over the world, there is some noise about how he knew about certain things — let’s see what happens next.”

Platini is suing Infantino, and former FIFA officials Marco Villiger and Domenico Scala, in France “to seek compensation for all the damages he has suffered as a result of the tactics used to prevent him from being elected FIFA president in 2015”.

He accuses the trio of a “criminal conspiracy to commit false accusation … influence peddling … and aiding and abetting influence peddling”.

articles.title: Women's Super League: Manchester United close to deal for Rebeca Bernal
articles.summary: Manchester United are close to signing Mexico international Rebeca Bernal from Washington Spirit.
articles.body:
Manchester United are close to signing Mexico international Rebeca Bernal from Washington Spirit.

The 29-year-old, who can play in the centre of either defence or midfield, would become the first Mexican to feature in the Women's Super League.

Bernal joined the Spirit in February 2025 from CF Monterrey and has played 41 times for them.

During her time in Washington, she won the NWSL Challenge Cup in 2025.

Bernal missed Spirit's NWSL game on Sunday against Bay FC with what the club described as an "excused absence".

She has also made 65 appearances for Mexico, scoring seven goals, including the winner in the 2023 Pan American Games women's football final as they beat Chile to claim the title for the first time.

United, who will start their WSL campaign under new manager Eva Olid at London City Lionesses on Friday, have signed defender Andrea Medina from Atletico Madrid, goalkeeper Janina Leitzig from Leicester City and Sweden winger Monica Jusu Bah from BK Hacken.

articles.title: Jude Bellingham: Jose Mourinho getting best out of England star as a No 10 at Real Madrid plus lots more in the Euro Debrief
articles.summary: With Jude Bellingham making a superb start, has Jose Mourinho got something going already at Real Madrid? Adam Bate picks out the big stories from the continent in the Euro Debrief, a Sky Sports column focusing on the major European leagues and more
articles.body:
Welcome to The Euro Debrief , a new Sky Sports column in which Adam Bate rounds up some of the key stories from the latest matches across the continent. This week:

Real Madrid made it three wins from three under Jose Mourinho with a 4-0 dismantling of Malaga in the Bernabeu. It has not been a daunting fixture list but there are signs that Mourinho has found a way to get the best from an increasingly stacked Madrid squad.

Trent Alexander-Arnold came in and produced a trademark assist, while Kylian Mbappe added to his midweek hat-trick against Real Sociedad with another goal here. But Jude Bellingham was the best player on the pitch against Malaga playing in that No 10 role.

Bellingham has been shifted around during his Madrid career, Carlo Ancelotti taking advantage of his broad skillset to fit him in deeper, out wide or up front. But Mourinho has been clear that he sees Bellingham playing off Mbappe and it is working very well.

Maybe it shouldn't be a surprise that Bellingham and Mourinho have hit it off. Back in 2024, the player did famously reveal that the coach was his mother's crush. More seriously, they share the same intense drive, demanding everything from those around them.

Against Malaga, Arda Guler came on to score the fourth, with Yan Diomande and Bernardo Silva also introduced as substitutes from a bench that included Ibrahima Konate, Denzel Dumfries and last week's hero Carlos Espi too. The depth at Madrid now is apparent.

It will get harder, of course, but as pointed out in the pages of Marca , how many of these sort of games have Madrid messed up in recent years? So far so good for Mourinho. With no sign yet of the feared tension with Vinicius Junior, he has the key players purring.

Elsewhere, there was a useful win for Atletico Madrid to end Sevilla's unlikely winning run. Troy Parrott looked lively for Betis but they were battered by Levante. And the 37-year-old Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang scored for a third game in a row for Deportivo.

But a word for Racing Santander, who won their first game of the LaLiga season at the third attempt. Racing have been to the third tier and back since their last top-flight win and beat Elche 3-2 by playing a brand of football that no other team in Spain is playing.

LaLiga results: Racing Santander 3-2 Elche, Alaves 1-0 Villarreal, Levante 5-2 Real Betis, Real Sociedad 2-1 Espanyol, Sevilla 1-3 Atletico Madrid, Real Madrid 4-0 Malaga, Deportivo A Coruna 3-1 Valencia, Celta Vigo 0-2 Athletic Club.

Bayern Munich kicked off the Bundesliga season on Friday with a 5-1 win over Stuttgart that highlighted their strength in depth. Harry Kane did not even score. But new signing Ismael Saibari showed just why Vincent Kompany's squad might have improved this season.

The Moroccan came off the bench to replace another new arrival in Nathaniel Brown and seized the chance by assisting Bayern's final two goals. Speaking to sporting director Christoph Freund about Saibari just last weekend, he explained the player's versatility.

"He is a little bit of a different style of player to Nicolas Jackson," said Freund. Not just a back-up for Kane. "I think he can play very well together with Harry Kane and he can play also on the wings. He is a really important signing." The best in Germany just got better.

For Borussia Dortmund, it was not such good news even as they beat Hamburg 2-0 with a goal from Giannis Konstantelias in his first start. That is because it will also be the Greek winger's last start for a while. He was forced off with a cruciate ligament injury.

It is a desperate blow for Niko Kovac's side given what an exciting start that he has made at Dortmund. But at least they won. The same could not be said of Bayer Leverkusen, who were humbled as they lost 3-2 to Elversberg, a side making their Bundesliga debut.

Elversberg were playing regional football as recently as 2022 but three promotions have put them among the elite. A victory over the 2024 Bundesliga champions on their bow is an astonishing start. The next visitors to this village club? That will be Bayern Munich.

Elsewhere, Yuito Suzuki scored a hat-trick as Freiburg beat Werder Bremen, while Augsburg enjoyed a 3-0 win over Schalke. Have a read of this interview with sporting director Benjamin Weber to find out more about how they plan to keep overachieving.

Bundesliga results: Bayern Munich 5-1 Stuttgart, Elversberg 3-2 Bayer Leverkusen, Cologne 3-2 Hoffenheim, Mainz 0-0 Paderborn, RB Leipzig 3-0 Borussia Monchengladbach, Union Berlin 3-3 Eintracht Frankfurt, Borussia Dortmund 2-0 Hamburg, Freiburg 4-1 Werder Bremen, Augsburg 3-0 Schalke.

Serie A: Como beat Napoli plus Ramos scores

The standout result in Serie A came in Naples as Como went and won 2-1. Rasmus Hojlund scored a quality goal for Napoli but it proved to be in vain as Cesc Fabregas has built a really good side, with Croatian player Martin Baturina particularly impressive.

Baturina scored the opener and it was his pressing that fashioned the winner for Anastasios Douvikas. A statement win for Como, although the four teams to have won each of their first four Serie A matches so far are Inter, Juventus, Lazio and AC Milan.

Ominously, champions Inter are top of the table already. They beat Cagliari 1-0 in Sardinia but that hardly reflected their dominance as they had 31 shots for an expected-goals total of 3.91. Curtis Jones and John Stones both came on for Inter as substitutes.

Meanwhile, Milan's 2-0 win over Venezia on Friday evening featured a busy performance from Goncalo Ramos that underlined why Milan paid that eye-catching £63m fee to sign him - and perhaps why PSG were content to allow the Portuguese striker to leave.

Ramos did eventually score the breakthrough goal midway through the second half but that was one of eight attempts at goal by the Portuguese forward - and there were no fewer than four big chances missed. Far from clinical but Ramos is a chance magnet.

Serie A results: AC Milan 2-0 Venezia, Fiorentina 0-3 Frosinone, Monza 2-3 Udinese, Sassuolo 2-1 Torino, Juventus 2-0 Parma, Napoli 1-2 Como, Cagliari 0-1 Inter, Lazio 1-0 Genoa.

Ligue 1: PSG wobble again but scrape a point

Paris Saint-Germain's uncertain start to the season continued as the reigning European champions needed two goals in stoppage time to salvage a 2-2 draw at Lille. Vitinha and Marquinhos managed the rescue job but PSG are now without a win in three games.

Nottingham Forest loanee Dilane Bakwa's strike on debut deserved to seal it for Lille. That was assisted by Olivier Giroud after the veteran had produced an even better pass to set up the first. But Vitinha scored a beauty then crossed for the leveller. Resilience from PSG.

Another caveat is that the two Ligue 1 games have been at Rennes and Lille - among the tougher tests. But it does mean that there is already only one team in the competition with a 100 per cent record - and that team is Monaco after their 2-0 win over Marseille.

The talented youngster Paris Brunner scored both goals in that one but when it comes to the actual city of Paris, the capital's highest-placed club as it stands is not PSG but Paris FC. Their 3-0 win over Nice takes them up to second spot in the fledgling Ligue 1 table.

Ligue 1 results: Lille 2-2 Paris Saint-Germain, Strasbourg 2-1 Lens, Auxerre 1-3 Angers, Brest 2-2 Toulouse, Lorient 1-2 Troyes, Lyon 1-1 Le Havre, Paris FC 3-0 Nice, Rennes 3-2 Le Mans, Monaco 2-0 Marseille.

Elsewhere: Perfect Porto and Ajax positives

Having dropped points at home to Academico de Viseu in their opening game, Benfica boss Marco Silva already looks to have his work cut out if he wants to prise the Portuguese title away from Francesco Farioli and his ruthlessly efficient Porto team.

The reigning champions made it four wins from four in the league and are yet to concede a goal in their title defence. Over in the Netherlands, it is AZ Alkmaar with the only perfect record. They are chasing a first title since Steve McClaren was in charge in 2009.

But the holders PSV signalled their intent with a 6-1 thrashing of Utrecht - despite conceding the first goal. Meanwhile, Ajax's new striker Tolu Arokodare continued his strong start by lashing in a fourth goal in three games in their 4-0 victory away to Telstar.

Ajax's struggles have become a soap opera but new boss Michel has delivered seven wins and two draws across all competitions to ensure they at least have a Conference League campaign to look forward to. An encouraging start but it is PSV next weekend.

articles.title: El Barcelona ficha al central del futuro
articles.standfirst: Matteo Moretto desvela en La Pizarra que el Barça tiene apalabrada la llegada de Mikael Baza, central alemán de 16 años que se incorporará al Barça Athletic
articles.summary: Matteo Moretto desvela en La Pizarra que el Barça tiene apalabrada la llegada de Mikael Baza, central alemán de 16 años que se incorporará al Barça Athletic
articles.body: El Barcelona sigue moviéndose en el mercado con la mirada puesta también en el futuro. Matteo Moretto desveló en La Pizarra que el conjunto azulgrana tiene prácticamente cerrada la incorporación de Mikael Baza, central alemán de sólo 16 años que llegará para reforzar el Barça Athletic. "El Barcelona apalabra la llegada de Mikael Baza, central alemán, joven de 16 años. Se va a incorporar al Barça Athletic. Hay acuerdo apalabrado entre las partes. El Barça pagaría los derechos de formación y un precio simbólico al Hamburgo. La negociación está básicamente cerrada", explicó Moretto. Además, el periodista aseguró que Gabriel Jesús está muy cerca del Barça: "Va a pasar reconocimiento médico. Está todo hecho". Una operación que, según sus informaciones, se ha cerrado "en 12 millones más 3 en variables" por el 80% del futbolista. El Atlético también se mueve en estas últimas horas. "Es la opción número uno para el Atlético de Madrid", afirmó Moretto sobre Jonathan David, aunque todavía "faltan flecos sobre la cifra final de la cesión remunerada que pide la Juve y sobre el salario del futbolista. El Atleti pide que la Juve pague una parte del salario". En cambio, descartó el regreso de Nico González: "Nico González no vuelve al Atlético de Madrid. La Juve descarta de manera definitiva su vuelta". Carlos Martín, por su parte, trabaja para abandonar el club cedido a algún equipo de Primera. Uno de los equipos con más urgencias es el Sevilla. "El Sevilla está desesperado. Ayer por la noche seguían peinando el mercado en busca de un delantero", explicó Moretto. El club hispalense ha insistido especialmente en Joselu: "En las últimas horas, el Sevilla ha contactado como diez veces a Joselu Mato", aunque "por una tema económico, de impuestos, es muy complicado que vuelva a LaLiga". También avanza el futuro de Dani Ceballos. "Finalmente, Ceballos y el Betis irán de la mano. El Betis sigue negociando y hablando. Ya tienen acuerdo con Ceballos", aseguró Moretto. El conjunto verdiblanco necesita ahora hacerle hueco tanto a nivel numérico como de masa salarial. Entre el resto de movimientos, Moretto aseguró que Petar Ratkov tiene "apalabrada" su llegada al Levante, Stefan Bajcetic llegará a España para firmar por el Celta y "el Valencia confía en cerrar la llegada de Harvey Elliott, del Liverpool". Además, el Fulham sigue apretando por Ratiu y podría incluso plantearse pagar su cláusula de 25 millones. Por su parte, el Rayo trabaja en la portería: "El Rayo está buscando un portero, sondeó la posible llegada de Keylor Navas".

articles.title: La explosión del Pichichi Jordi Sánchez en Polonia
articles.standfirst: El catalán lleva seis goles en seis partidos y ha colocado al recién ascendido Wisla de Cracovia tercero en la tabla
articles.summary: El catalán lleva seis goles en seis partidos y ha colocado al recién ascendido Wisla de Cracovia tercero en la tabla
articles.body: A Jordi Sánchez se le caen los goles en Polonia. El delantero catalán se ha convertido en el máximo artillero de la Ekstraklasa con un promedio espectacular que está llamando la atención. Seis goles en seis partidos para colocar al recién ascendido Wisla de Cracovia tercero en la tabla solo superado por el Legia de Varsovia y empatado a puntos con el Lech Poznan. La historia de Jordi, un trotamundos del fútbol tiene miga. Siempre fue un goleador, un buen delantero que probó en mil aventuras. Ahora, en Polonia, ha encontrado su explosión con 31 años y una carrera a sus espaldas. La pasada campaña fue uno de los jugadores importantes del equipo en segunda división y logró el ascenso, este año es el Pichichi de la Liga con seis goles en seis partidos quedándose solo en uno de ellos sin marcar. Jordi nació en Barcelona y en equipos locales empezó a marcar goles ya de muy pequeño. Firmó por el Badalona y ahí empezó su paso por varios equipos de cantera. Llegó al Valencia Mestalla y desde Paterna dio el salto al Numancia, el Ibiza, el Castellón, el Murcia, el Albacete... en España siempre fue un delantero de equipo y ante la falta de una oportunidad más potente, decidió emprender la aventura fuera de las fronteras nacionales. Su primera salida fue al Widzew polaco, de allí dio el salto a Japón y firmó por el Sapporo. En el país Nipón no fueron bien las cosas y decidió volver a Polonia dónde había dejado un buen sabor de boca. Le firmó el Wisla en segunda y el año pasado lograron el ascenso. Esta temporada el español ha empezado como un avión. Seis goles, con doblete incluido en la segunda jornada y titular indiscutible. En el Wisla comparte vestuario con una buena legión de españoles: Marc Carbó, Víctor Meseguer y Ángel Rodado (capitán del equipo) le dan el acento castellano a un equipo en el que Jordi ha cogido la responsabilidad del gol. El catalán tiene contrato hasta junio y si sigue con esta racha anotadora será complicado que en Polonia puedan retenerle. El gol se paga y a Jordi, en este inicio de campaña, se le caen de los bolsillos.

articles.title: "Los jugadores creen en el plan de Mourinho"
articles.standfirst: Látigo Serrano destaca en La Tribu la confianza del vestuario blanco en su entrenador y pronostica que el Real Madrid superará los 90 puntos en LaLiga
articles.summary: Látigo Serrano destaca en La Tribu la confianza del vestuario blanco en su entrenador y pronostica que el Real Madrid superará los 90 puntos en LaLiga
articles.body: Látigo Serrano, José Luis Sánchez, Fernando Kallás, Antonio Sanz, David Bernabéu y Jorge Liaño han sido los tertulianos de este lunes en La Tribu, patrocinada por Sportium durante esta temporada, para analizar la victoria del Real Madrid ante el Málaga, el pleno de Mourinho, el gran momento de Bellingham y el fichaje de Gabriel Jesús por el Barcelona. Látigo Serrano. "Es evidente que este Madrid va a competir y que por primera vez en los últimos años, a excepción de Alonso, el entrenador tiene un plan, sabe lo que quiere hacer, y los jugadores se creen el plan, algo que con Xabi Alonso no pasaba. Xabi tenía un plan pero a los jugadores no les gustaba, no creían en el entrenador. Mourinho sabe lo que quiere hacer y los jugadores creen en lo que quiere hacer. Se me antoja imposible que el Madrid no esté por encima de los 90 puntos en LaLiga, igual que el Barça". José Luis Sánchez. "Al Real Madrid le han cambiado la cara, no tiene nada que ver con el de la temporada pasada. Es intenso, dinámico, que se mueve, muerde, combina rápido. El faro, la guía de este equipo, es Bellingham, su nivel es extraordinario. Mourinho está empezando a solucionar todos los problemas que tenía el Real Madrid en temporadas anteriores. El fichaje de Cucurella le da un plus de intensidad al equipo. El Madrid vuelve a ser un equipo en mayúsculas". Fernando Kallás. "El fichaje estratégico de Cucurella ha cambiado completamente la banda izquierda. Bellingham, con total libertad para ser mediapunta, está impresionante. El arranque de Mbappé es espectacular, está en una forma extraordinaria. Vinicius quizá está en una marcha un poco más lenta. Es bastante positivo el principio de temporada del Madrid". Antonio Sanz. "El Madrid lo hizo muy bien. Un buen arranque es un buen síntoma. Auguro un mano a mano entre Barça y Real Madrid. Mourinho se va a aferrar en 15-16 jugadores, de ellos dependerá el éxito". David Bernabéu. "El Madrid ha empezado bien, pero el Málaga no fue rival. Raphinha y Fermín han hecho dos exhibiciones en los dos primeros partidos y llevan los mismos goles que Bellingham. Dani Olmo hizo un Mundial casi superior al de Bellingham... Se exagera todo solo por tres partidos". Jorge Liaño. "No se puede juzgar al Madrid por estos partidos. LaLiga se va a ir a más de 100 puntos. Madrid y Barça son peores que cuando estaban Mourinho y Guardiola, pero el resto de equipos son muy malos, son mediocres".

articles.title: Airlink stunt: South African airline defends low-altitude flight over packed stadium
articles.summary: Airlink says the manoeuvre with two planes in close formation involved careful and precise planning.
articles.body:
A South African airline has defended itself against some criticism of a dramatic stunt that saw two of its aircraft in close formation fly reportedly within feet of the top of a stadium.

The jets roared over Cape Town's DHL Stadium, filled with more than 50,000 fans, as smoke flares shot up before the start of a rugby match featuring fierce rivals South Africa and New Zealand.

As videos of Saturday's aerial feat were shared, some labelled the startling manoeuvre reckless, while others have praised the precision and expertise required to pull it off.

In response, Airlink said it was carefully planned with the support of the aviation authorities.

"Planning. Precision. Performance," was the airline's message in social media posts accompanied by the footage.

"The two aircraft were flown by highly experienced crew, with each comprised of three senior captains operating in the roles of commander, co-pilot and safety/technical officer," the airline said.

It added that the flights were performed with the "approved and rehearsed safety altitude and speed limits for the flypast".

The flight tracking website Flightradar24 said that according to its analysis "the lead aircraft passed less than 50 feet (15 metres) above the top of the stadium".

Questions have been raised over the risk and potential for disaster involving two planes and a packed stadium, but many South Africans have responded with expressions of national pride that its country's pilots could pull this off.

"It's a well known fact that we have the best pilots in the world, that was spectacular," Sports Minister Gayton McKenzie wrote on X .

The low-altitude flyby has become a feature of the build-up to some big matches in South Africa.

The most notable was when a South African Airways jet flew over Johannesburg's Ellis Park stadium before the start of the 1995 rugby World Cup final which saw South Africa beat New Zealand.

The match, immortalised in the Hollywood film Invictus, was highly symbolic as the country's first black president, Nelson Mandela, donned the jersey of the national side, which had been closely associated with the apartheid government and previously excluded players who were not white.

articles.title: Folarin Balogun to Everton? Former Arsenal striker is a 'natural finisher' who forged his own path to the top with France move and USA switch
articles.summary: Everton want to sign Folarin Balogun from Monaco so what would he bring? Former Arsenal striker scored three goals for USA at the World Cup and has shone in France; his personal coach describes him as a "natural finisher" with potential to be one of world's best No 9s
articles.body:
"He's very serious and he's very driven," Isaksson-Hurst tells Sky Sports . "He'll sometimes come and say, 'look, I want to do this'. He's not backwards about coming forward with what he wants to work on. We'll often discuss it and have a back and forth.

"He challenges me as much as I try to challenge him. But it's great to work with him because he always brings it, that mentality, that intensity. You know you're doing a session with a top, top player because it's always at 100 per cent."

It is a revealing insight into the mind of a player who has taken an active role in his own development, typified by his decision to enlist the help of Isaksson-Hurst following a difficult loan spell with Middlesbrough while he was still a teenager at Arsenal.

Balogun returned having only scored three goals in 18 Championship games. He was determined not to let it define him. "He wanted to do more. He wanted to get better," explains Isaksson-Hurst. "He was a very targeted and aspirational type of guy."

Their first sessions took place that summer. "We had an intensive few weeks of training in London, really focused on him as a profile, that number nine, that fox in the box who's great at finishing. Both feet, movements, timing of runs. Those sorts of things."

Balogun's subsequent success on loan at Reims, where he scored 22 goals in 39 games, showed the value of the extra work. Now 25, he has been training with Isaksson-Hurst ever since, booking in sessions in the off-season or during breaks in his schedule.

Balogun found himself at the centre of a political storm following his red card at the World Cup but showed his quality at the tournament with three goals. He is now being linked with a return to the Premier League with Everton, three years after leaving Arsenal for Monaco, where he has scored 31 times in 91 appearances.

His career has been a story of bold decisions. Balogun left his comfort zone with his move to France, initially with his loan to Reims, then switched his international allegiance from England to the USA.

"He just wants to play at the highest level he can, on the biggest stage possible," says Isaksson-Hurst, who works with several top players having previously been an academy coach.

A return to the Premier League would put him back in the spotlight.

"I don't see him struggling under that pressure. I think he'd excel under it. It's what he looks for. He wants that. He has always sought that out. That's why he challenges himself to do extras, to get those marginal gains and be the best player he can be."

Balogun's World Cup form was a continuation of an impressive scoring streak at Monaco, where he finished the campaign with 11 goals in 14 games, sparked by a double in a Champions League meeting with Paris Saint-Germain in February.

But he has had to come through difficult moments since his £35m move from Arsenal in 2023 too. There have been injury problems and periods in which he has struggled to hold down a starting spot. Balogun, though, has a long history of overcoming adversity.

His time at Arsenal ended in frustration but he is fondly remembered by academy staff as a tireless worker.

At Middlesbrough, he made a similar impression on former manager Chris Wilder and his assistant Alan Knill, who were struck by his mental strength despite the difficulties he encountered there.

"It's part of the game," says Isaksson-Hurst. "He needed those challenges to help him develop and hopefully become one of the best players in the world."

Isaksson-Hurst has observed the hardening of Balogun's mentality over a period of several years. He describes it as the most striking aspect of his development as a player.

"I think he's obviously always had that raw talent. He's always been a natural finisher. He's really worked on refining that and he's also developed other areas of his game, his timing and movements, the way he comes into the box and his link-up play.

"But seeing him as a young man to a man now, I think seeing his mentality has really stood out, how he's made that journey. He was always really ambitious. Like I said, he contacted me in the first place because he wanted to do more.

"But seeing him in the last block of sessions we did showed how serious and focused he is in terms of wanting to be one of the best number nines in world football and wanting to put the work in and prove to everyone that he can do it at the highest level."

That mindset has kept Balogun on track even when circumstances have been challenging. He also benefits from being a profile of a player, as an out-and-out striker who comes alive inside the opposition penalty box, increasingly rare in top-level football.

Everton are not alone in their need for a reliable goalscorer.

"Scoring goals is the hardest thing to do in football," adds Isaksson-Hurst. "But his ability off both feet and in the air as well is top. That's not easy because there aren't that many number nines around.

"A lot players playing as number nines aren't real orthodox number nines. They're sevens or 11s playing as nines. Flo is a natural, a fox in the box who can finish. Give him half a yard and he's going to punish you. That's what sets him apart from everyone else."

Coupled with the mentality that has driven the restlessly ambitious Balogun to this point, it is a dangerous combination.

articles.title: Paris Brunner, el 'Balón de Oro maldito' que Filipe Luís ha convertido en el 'regen' de Mbappé
articles.standfirst: El ex del Borussia Dortmund acumula cuatro goles en cuatro partidos con el Mónaco
articles.summary: El ex del Borussia Dortmund acumula cuatro goles en cuatro partidos con el Mónaco
articles.body: El nombre de Paris Josua Brunner (Dortmund, 2006) estaba anotado con letras de oro en las direcciones deportivas de todos los grandes de Europa. El canterano del Borussia Dortmund saltó a la palestra después de marcar ¡¡¡16 goles!!! en sólo cinco partidos con el sub 17 del 'BVB'. Su 2023 fue inmejorable. Condujo a Alemania a ganar el Europeo y el Mundial sub 17. No sólo eso. Brunner se coronó 'MVP' y 'Pichichi' del Europeo, se llevó el Balón de Oro del Mundial y recibió la medalla Fritz Walter al mejor jugador alemán menor de 17 años. Al igual que Youssoufa Moukoko, el atacante -puede jugar de '9' o de extremo- parecía destinado a debutar con el primer equipo más pronto que tarde. De pronto, algo se torció. El Borussia Dortmund le suspendió "hasta nuevo aviso" por razones disciplinarias. Brunner, que marcó 26 goles y repartió 10 asistencias en 42 partidos con el sub 19 del 'BVB', no llegó a jugar nunca con los 'mayores'. Es más, en agosto de 2024 se marchó traspasado al Mónaco por 4 millones de euros y, de inmediato, se fue cedido al Círculo Brujas. En Bélgica marcó seis tantos en 28 partidos (20 como suplente)... pero no deslumbró. El curso pasado, de vuelta al Principado, tampoco despegó. Ni con Adi Hütter, ni con Sébastien Pocognoli. Sólo disputó 127 minutos repartidos en siete partidos. El desembarco de Filipe Luís en el Louis II le ha cambiado la vida. Los cinco goles que marcó en pretemporada entrando desde el banquillo -incluyendo los goles de la victoria contra Liverpool (2-3) y Getafe (1-0)- le abrieron las puertas del once. Ayudó, eso sí, la falta de competencia. Matthis Abline está recién llegado, Folarin Balogun espera marcharse al Everton, Ansu Fati continúa con su puesta a punto... Brunner, esta vez sí, no ha defraudado: clasificó al Mónaco para la Conference marcando en la ida y en la vuelta de los 'playoffs' ante el Górnik Zabrze y terminó de reivindicarse con un doblete en Ligue 1 frente al Olympique de Marsella (2-0). Abrió la lata en el 13' al cabecear un centro de Aleksandr Golovin y firmó el 2-0 en el 53' con una obra maestra que hizo recordar a Kylian Mbappé. Eric Dier sacó de puerta en largo y Brunner se quitó de encima a Geoffrey Kondogbia con una carrera de 50 metros. La puntilla, para Kondogbia y CJ Egan-Riley, llegó con un doble recorte en seco con la diestra antes de batir a Lukas Hradecky, mano a mano, con la zurda. Un golazo que venía con premio. Situó al Mónaco líder en solitario de la Ligue 1 -suma seis puntos en dos jornadas- antes de visitar al Paris Saint-Germain el viernes. "Fue una dura batalla contra Kondogbia, siempre estaba justo detrás de mí. Vi espacio a mi espalda, lo regateé y aproveché la oportunidad. He marcado goles más bonitos en las categorías inferiores, pero éste es más importante", reconocía Brunner. A Filipe Luís le ha conquistado. "Me lo pone difícil para decidir la alineación titular, porque cada vez que entra, marca. Tiene hambre de gol, siempre entra con muchas ganas y energía. Ésa es la mentalidad que busco. Me alegra tener este quebradero de cabeza a la hora de decidir la alineación titular; es lo mejor que me podría pasar, tener buenos jugadores luchando por un puesto", admitía el entrenador del Mónaco tras su gol al Liverpool. Tras su doblete ante el 'OM', volvió a rendirse a Brunner: "Estuvo fantástico. Es el tipo de jugador que, desde mi llegada, se ha expresado en el campo, a través de los entrenamientos, los goles, la presión, las contribuciones defensivas; quiere aprender. Estoy muy contento con él, pero lo más importante es que mantenga su ambición y pasión, porque juega con pasión. Mientras lo haga, estará aquí". Tras casi cuatro años de su explosión, el 'Balón de Oro maldito' vuelve a brillar.

articles.title: 2026 Preseason College Football Playoff Bracket Projections and Predictions
articles.summary: Following an eight-game Week 0 slate, the 2026 season is officially underway. The march to the College Football Playoff is on.
articles.body:
Following an eight-game Week 0 slate, the 2026 season is officially underway. The march to the College Football Playoff is on.

At last, our final preseason predictions are due.

Bowl eligibility is nice, and contending for a conference title is valuable. But the ultimate goal, for every program within the Football Bowl Subdivision, is earning a spot in the 12-team CFP field to chase a national championship.

These projections—which follow a refresher of the CFP format and B/R's Top 25 to open the season—are a personal outlook on the 2026 campaign.

As with seemingly everything else in the sport, the College Football Playoff has undergone some notable changes for the 2026 season.

Most importantly, the path to an automatic bid has changed. In both 2024 and 2025, the five highest-ranked conference champions—no matter their league affiliation—landed a spot in the CFP.

The rules are different in 2026 due to a memorandum of understanding signed in March 2024. This year, the winners of the Power Four conferences—the ACC, Big Ten, Big 12 and SEC—are guaranteed a Playoff invite.

Additionally, the highest-ranked Group of 6 program will receive a bid, even if it is not a conference champion.

Notre Dame secured some unparalleled protection for itself, as well. If the Fighting Irish are 12th or better in the final CFP rankings, they're in. Again, that MOU was signed in March 2024. The change is not in response to ND's end-of-season drama a year ago—but it sure is a timely coincidence.

1. Oregon 2. Ohio State 3. Notre Dame 4. Miami 5. Georgia 6. Texas 7. Indiana 8. Texas Tech 9. Ole Miss 10. Texas A&M 11. Oklahoma 12. LSU 13. Alabama 14. USC 15. BYU 16. Washington 17. SMU 18. Utah 19. Michigan 20. Tennessee 21. Louisville 22. Penn State 23. Houston 24. Iowa 25. Kansas State

Throughout the season, the bracket projections will be based on B/R's Top 25. Entering the campaign, though, this is an individual prediction—one that assuredly won't go terribly wrong by, like, Week 4.

Power 4 Champions and Top Group of 6 Team

First-round games will be played on the campuses of teams seeded fifth to eighth.

This postseason, the Fiesta Bowl, Peach Bowl, Rose Bowl and Cotton Bowl will serve as the four quarterfinal sites.

The semifinals will be played at the Orange Bowl and Sugar Bowl, and Las Vegas will host the CFP national championship.

When discussing the biggest game of the opening month, the easy answer is Ohio State at Texas. It should be a battle of Top Five teams in Austin.

Several teams, though, have at least two early showdowns.

LSU headlines the group with three huge matchups, kicking off the campaign at home against Clemson. After a (theoretical) tune-up game, the Tigers head to Ole Miss in Week 3 prior to hosting Texas A&M. Few teams face a tougher September slate.

Ole Miss, meanwhile, has that LSU contest after meeting Louisville in a neutral-site opener. Also in Week 3, Louisville takes on SMU in a likely Top 25 clash.

Wrapping up this group, Oklahoma is set to play at Michigan and Georgia during the opening month. Dropping both games would put a serious dent in the Sooners' hopes of returning to the CFP before October even begins.

articles.title: Harry Maguire backs Marcus Rashford to make big Man Utd impact
articles.summary: Manchester United defender Harry Maguire is backing Marcus Rashford to make a big impact at the club this season.
articles.body:
Manchester United defender Harry Maguire is confident Marcus Rashford will have a significant impact at the club this season.

The 28-year-old started his first Premier League game for United in 21 months in the 5-2 victory over Ipswich at Old Trafford, and was one of his side's main attacking threats.

Having a future at United seemed unlikely when he fell out with former boss Ruben Amorim and was loaned out to Aston Villa and then Barcelona, where he would have stayed had the Catalans activated a £26m transfer fee.

With the transfer window closing on Tuesday night, it now looks certain Rashford will remain at his boyhood club.

"He's a great talent," said Maguire. "He's always a threat.

"If Marcus wants to be here, wants to work, wants to improve and help the team, of course we're willing to have him in the team.

"He could still do a lot more and I think he'll say he can do more but if we keep him fit, we keep him happy, he keeps driven and hungry, he's a great asset to have."

There has been plenty of negativity around Rashford, even dating back to Erik ten Hag's time at the club.

His work-rate and commitment have been questioned as well as the basic question of whether he actually enjoys the game any more.

Rashford did appear to benefit from working with Unai Emery and Hansi Flick during his time away from Old Trafford and the fact head coach Michael Carrick knows him well is felt to be an advantage.

"You've got to remember Marcus has had a wonderful career for this club," said Maguire.

"But when you play at this club for numerous years, there's going to be bad seasons, and when the bad seasons come everyone piles on you. That's part and parcel of playing for this club.

"As a club, we haven't been perfect from top to bottom. We haven't been challenging at the top end. So, Marcus has been part of a rough ride for Manchester United .

"When that happens, players get dug out. I've been through it," added Maguire, who also looked to be leaving the club at one stage after losing both his place in the team and the captaincy under former boss Erik ten Hag.

"He's come back in, really fit and sharp and we're excited to have him."

Carrick describes Rashford as being like a new signing and while the United boss rejuvenated midfielder Kobbie Mainoo after he was repeatedly overlooked by predecessor Amorim, he now has to lift his spirits again after England boss Thomas Tuchel did not play him at the World Cup.

Mainoo also started for the first time this season against Ipswich and grew into the game after United went behind.

"I thought he was brilliant," said Maguire.

"To say he hasn't had many minutes in pre-season, he was magnificent.

"His work without the ball has improved so much since Michael's been in. He's becoming a real monster in there, wins a lot of second balls and a lot of duels.

"The thing is he's so young. If we want him to play for this club for another 10 years, there's going to be times where he's going to go through a patch like I spoke about with Rashy and myself.

"But that's part and parcel. He's really level-headed, really composed and has great belief in his ability.

"He's going to be a magnificent player for this club for many years."

With Rashford staying at United, Netherlands forward Joshua Zirkzee appears to be the most likely senior player to leave the club before the transfer window closes.

However, a proposed loan move to Serie A outfit Fiorentina for the 25-year-old has now been scrapped.

It is possible Juventus might come in for the Netherlands forward, who has been an unused substitute for both Manchester United games so far, although that is dependent on Canada forward Jonathan David completing a move to Atletico Madrid.

That might be key in whether United make additions to Carrick's squad, and he did not totally rule the possibility of new arrivals after yesterday's 5-2 victory over Ipswich at Old Trafford.

"It's always difficult to say, to be honest, when there's so little time left but we're always open if there's something else to be able to add," he said.

"I wouldn't shut that down, but as it stands, we'll have to wait and see."

articles.title: El día y la noche para el Granada
articles.standfirst: Los rojiblancos han cambiando la historia del pasado curso en tres jornadas
articles.summary: Los rojiblancos han cambiando la historia del pasado curso en tres jornadas
articles.body: A expensas de lo que ocurra en el duelo que enfrenta al filial del Celta y al Castellón, el Granada ha logrado encaramarse a lo más alto de la tabla, viviendo una situación de privilegio que solo pudo contemplar desde la distancia la pasada temporada, un cambio total de paradigma que ha conseguido Pacheta con un grupo ecléctico entre manos. El pasado curso, tras tres jornadas disputadas, los rojiblancos no habían sumado ningún punto, tras sucumbir ante Deportivo, Eibar y Mirandés, con un balance de ocho goles en contra y tan solo dos tantos a favor, una situación que contrasta poderosamente con el momento actual, en el que los andaluces han arrancado la competición de forma sorprendente, logrando un punto en el Tartiere y doblegando a Mallorca y Córdoba, rivales de primera línea a los que se ha enfrentado sin complejos. El año pasado, los de Pacheta no puntuaron hasta la cuarta jornada y no lograron su segundo triunfo hasta la octava fecha del calendario, un inicio catastrófico que sirvió como aprendizaje y como gasolina para que la historia no se repitiese, una misión que los rojiblancos han cumplido con nota, demostrando que este Granada no tiene nada que ver con el de la anterior campaña. El técnico burgalés ha conseguido moldear un equipo reconocible, con carácter y con las ideas muy claras, indigesto para los rivales, rocoso en defensa y con pegada en los últimos metro, una receta que parece ganadora y con la que los rojiblancos pretenden asentarse en el pelotón de cabeza durante todo el curso. Con un equipo que ha convertido la resiliencia en su bandera, el reto ahora es no caer en la autocomplacencia y mantener viva la llama competitiva porque, como se ha apresurado a advertir Pacheta, cualquier delirio de grandeza es castigado con severidad en una categoría como Segunda, por lo que el trabajo y la humildad siguen siendo el camino para este Granada que parece haber resurgido.

articles.title: Jeremy Monga: Swansea City to sign Manchester City winger as Leo Walta to leave
articles.summary: Manchester City winger Jeremy Monga is set for a season at Swansea City, who will allow Finland international Leo Walta to join Los Angeles on loan.
articles.body:
Swansea City are poised to complete the loan signing of Manchester City's Jeremy Monga and will let Leo Walta leave the club on loan.

A deal has been agreed to recruit 17-year-old winger Monga, who is due to travel to Swansea to undergo a medical with a view to completing a season-long loan switch prior to Tuesday's 23:00 BST transfer deadline.

Finland international Walta was omitted from the matchday squad for Swansea's 3-0 win at Derby County on Saturday and is set to join Major League Soccer side Los Angeles.

It comes as Championship side Swansea are also closing in on the signing of Huddersfield Town midfielder Tom Iorpenda.

Swans close in on Huddersfield midfielder Iorpenda

Swansea can still improve after unbeaten start - Matos

Monga is a product of Leicester City's academy and made his senior debut for the Foxes as a 15-year-old during the 2024-25 campaign.

He featured 30 times for Leicester in the Championship last season before signing a five-year deal with Man City earlier this summer.

During his time at Leicester, Monga became the youngest goal scorer in the Championship when he netted in his side's 2-1 defeat by Preston North End in August last year.

Upon completing the signing of Monga earlier this summer, City director of football Hugo Viana hailed the teenager as an "exciting player" and added he has "already made huge strides in his young career".

The England Under-19 international is now set to spend the remainder of the current campaign on loan with Vitor Matos' side.

The Swans have already bolstered their wide options with the additions of Elijah Just, Moussa Yeo and Joseph Opoku this summer.

Walta joined on an initial loan deal from Swedish outfit Sirius in February - a switch that was made permanent by the Swans earlier this summer.

His sole league appearance this season came as a late substitute in Swansea's opening day 2-1 win at Stoke City - although he also came off the bench in his side's 1-0 EFL Cup first round loss to Birmingham City.

The 23-year-old made 10 league appearances for Swansea in the latter stages of the 2025-26 season and scored his only goal for the club in a 3-1 victory over Charlton Athletic on the final day of the campaign.

Latest Swansea City news, analysis and fan views

Listen to the latest Swansea City interviews, news and discussion on BBC Sounds

Swansea's midfield department has undergone numerous changes over recent months.

The Swans sold Ethan Galbraith to Championship rivals Stoke City earlier this summer and are also without Goncalo Franco until October after the Portuguese midfielder underwent ankle surgery.

Matos has already bolstered his options in the centre of the park by recruiting Canada international Stephen Eustaquio from Porto.

That deal came after Swansea signed New Zealand international Just - who can play out wide or centrally - from Scottish outfit Motherwell.

They also have Jay Fulton, Melker Widell and Marko Stamenic in midfield while summer signing Moussa Yeo, who is predominantly a winger, can operate as an attacking midfielder.

Swansea - who remain unbeaten in the league this season - return to Championship action against Watford at the Swansea.com Stadium on Tuesday night (19:45 BST).

articles.title: Jonathan David, todo listo para el nuevo 9
articles.standfirst: El punta de la Juve, principal opción del Atlético para reforzar su punta de lanza
articles.summary: El punta de la Juve, principal opción del Atlético para reforzar su punta de lanza
articles.body: “Es la principal opción”, deslizan desde el Metropolitano hablando de Jonathan David como el mejor colocado para reforzar la parcela ofensiva del Atlético en estas últimas horas de mercado. Una opción en la que se avanza para que dé tiempo a formalizar la llegada vía préstamo. Los rojiblancos se guardarían una opción de compra de 25 millones. Con 26 años, el punta de la Juve se queda en primera posición de una carrera que llegó a liderar Nico Jackson pero que ahora tiene al canadiense como gran baza para subir el nivel de una punta de lanza en la que estarán Julián (salvo giro inesperado de última hora) y un Sorloth que lleva tiempo siendo intocable en la plantilla. David, con contrato hasta 2030 con lo de Turín, llegó libre hace un año pero no se ha asentado (marcó 8 goles en los 46 partidos que disputó el curso paso) en la Juve como se esperaba. De ahí la opción rojiblanca sobre el jugador que saltó a la primera línea mediática en la temporada 24-25 en las filas del Lille, donde fue clave en las históricas victorias ante el Madrid (gol suyo) y en el Metropolitano (doblete). Los 25 goles que marcó en aquel curso son el mejor aval del delantero, que superó los 100 tantos (109 y 31 asistencias) en el Lille. Recuperar ese nivel es el reto del delantero y del cuerpo técnico de Simeone si finalmente David acaba llegando en estas últimas horas de mercado. Esa cesión es una fórmula con la que ya llegó Nico González (que este año finalmente no regresará como adelantó ayer MARCA) hace un año. Con las apreturas económicas y sin apenas margen, la opción de David es la que más cuadra a la dirección deportiva del Atlético, que ya tiene el 9 que ha tomado la delantera.

articles.title: El Girona ficha al lateral Mateu Morey
articles.standfirst: El defensa se compromete hasta junio de 2029
articles.summary: El defensa se compromete hasta junio de 2029
articles.body: El jugador balear Mateu Jaume Morey se ha convertido este lunes en nuevo jugador del Girona, procedente del Mallorca, y junto a Javi Boñar, incorporado del Atlético de Madrid, serán los sustitutos de Arnau Martínez, traspasado al Valencia después de varias temporadas como dueño del lateral derecho del equipo catalán. Morey, de 26 años, se ha comprometido con el Girona hasta 2029 y llega a Montilivi después de jugar 38 partidos en las dos últimas temporadas con el Mallorca, su club de origen. El comunicado del club catalán asegura que es "un lateral derecho completo" que destaca por su "potencia física, velocidad, capacidad defensiva e intensidad en los duelos y para incorporarse al ataque y llegar a zona de finalización" y que aportará "una amplia experiencia en la élite". El nuevo '3' rojiblanco ha competido en LaLiga con el Mallorca y en la Bundesliga y la Liga de Campeones con el Borrussia Dortmund. Además, fue internacional con las selección española sub-17 y sub-21. En 2017 fue campeón de Europa sub-17 y en 2018 la Liga de Campeones juvenil con el Barcelona, club en el que se formó. Morey es la octava incorporación del proyecto catalán tras los también defensas Boñar, Mauro Furtado y Abdul Mumin; los centrocampistas Unai Hernández, Izan González e Iván Morante; y el delantero Oleksandr Pyshchur.

articles.title: Aïmen Moueffek refuerza el centro del campo del Cádiz
articles.standfirst: Llega cedido por el AS Saint-Étienne hasta el final de la temporada
articles.summary: Llega cedido por el AS Saint-Étienne hasta el final de la temporada
articles.body: El Cádiz ha oficializado la incorporación de Aïmen Moueffek, que llega cedido por el AS Saint-Étienne hasta el final de la temporada. El mediocentro franco-marroquí, de 25 años, se convierte en un nuevo refuerzo para la plantilla de Albert Celades en la recta final del mercado. El fichaje ha pasado reconocimiento médico en la Clínica San Rafael y apuntala una línea que necesitaba ser reforzada, tal y como reconoció el propio Albert Celades tras el empate ante el Real Valladolid. Moueffek se formó en la cantera del Saint-Étienne y ha desarrollado toda su carrera profesional en el conjunto francés. Su llegada aporta al Cádiz una alternativa más para una posición que Celades consideraba prioritaria. Tras el empate contra el Valladolid, el técnico reconoció públicamente que el equipo necesitaba aumentar sus efectivos en el centro del campo. Con esta incorporación, el Cádiz queda pendiente de resolver la situación de Joaquín González. El centrocampista no entra en los planes del club y su posible salida antes del cierre del mercado fue adelantada por Radio MARCA Cádiz. Además, el club también espera dar salida al delantero argentino Jero Dómina, y en su lugar llegará el ariete uruguayo Gonzalo Petit en forma de cesión desde el Real Betis. Además, el Cádiz también ha hecho oficial en la mañana de este lunes el traspaso de Iker Recio al CD Eldense, donde firma por las dos próximas temporadas.

articles.title: Allan: Man City sign Palmeiras winger for £34m
articles.summary: Manchester City complete the signing of winger Allan Elias from Palmeiras in a deal worth up to £34.2m.
articles.body:
Manchester City have signed winger Allan Elias from Palmeiras in a deal worth up to £34.2m.

City have paid an initial £32m plus £2.2m in add-ons for the 22-year-old Brazilian, who has signed a five-year contract.

Allan is a direct replacement for compatriot Savio, who completed a £75m move to Tottenham Hotspur last week.

The right-sided winger scored nine goals and provided 12 assists in 96 appearances in all competitions for Brazilian top-flight side Palmeiras after progressing through the club's youth system.

"This is a surreal moment for me. Manchester City , with everything they have won over the past 15 years, are one of the most attractive clubs in the world for players," Allan said.

"To be able to sit here today and say I have joined them is the proudest moment of my life.

"I love Palmeiras and always will - but the decision to come to City was an easy one. I want to be the best footballer I can be and the conversations I've had with the people at City so far has convinced me there isn't a better place for me to fulfil my ambitions."

Allan is the latest addition to Enzo Maresca's squad during a busy summer window.

City have spent over £230m so far this summer with Elliot Anderson arriving from Nottingham Forest for £116m and Ayyoub Bouaddi joining for £85.6m from Lille.

City are in talks with Liverpool over a move for Dutch forward Cody Gakpo and are keen to sign Chelsea midfielder Enzo Fernandez.

However, City have raised over £286m in player sales with 2026 World Cup Golden Ball winner Rodri making a £65m move to Barcelona, and Tijani Reijnders joining Al-Qadsiah for £52m.

Nico Gonzalez and James Trafford also commanded significant fees, while Omar Marmoush's loan to Tottenham includes an obligation to make the move permanent next summer for £60m.

articles.title: Driouech: "Creo que en el Celta puedo consagrarme"
articles.standfirst: El último fichaje céltico fue presentado este lunes
articles.summary: El último fichaje céltico fue presentado este lunes
articles.body: Couhaib Driouech está feliz de haber fichado por el Celta y deseando debutar. El ex de PSV así lo expresó en su presentación de este lunes, en la cual el consejero, Sergio Álvarez, dijo: “Desearle todo lo mejor en el campo que es lo que queremos todos, que sea feliz, que disfrute del fútbol y dé su mejor versión para que el Celta compita lo mejor posible y todos estemos felices”. El director de fútbol céltico, Marco Garcés, señaló: “Nos puede dar esas características que venimos buscando desde hace varias ventanas, alguien que en el último tercio tenga esa habilidad, ese uno contra uno, ese desborde, capacidad de generar oportunidades de gol y goles que tan bien nos vendrían en este momento. Estamos muy contentos de su incorporación, creemos que él nos puede dar todas esas cosas que el equipo necesita, que Claudio necesita, y felices de que esté aquí”. El futbolista dijo sentirse bien físicamente: “Me siento muy bien, estoy en forma, llevo entrenando varias semanas con el grupo. Sufrí una pequeña rotura pero nada serio, un pequeño contratiempo de un par de semanas pero ya estoy en plenitud de condiciones". Se define como futbolista: "Vengo jugando por la izquierda pero ya en mi club anterior he jugado bastante por la derecha. Siento que soy un jugador de corte ofensivo y puedo jugar donde sea necesario en la parcela de ataque. Soy un jugador peligroso, siento que soy muy directo y que tengo muy buen uno contra uno. Me gusta buscar los espacios profundos y que me busquen los compañeros a la espalda”. Espera seguir creciendo: “Tengo 24 años y siento que tengo mucho que mejorar. Por eso este es un buen sitio en el que progresar. Los entrenadores me pueden ayudar mucho a desarrollarme y siento que es un buen sitio en el que me pueden ayudar a tener más regularidad y ganar consistencia en mi juego que había tenido momentos de jugar menos y aquí creo que puedo consagrarme y jugar con más regularidad. Yo me considero un jugador de equipo y mi responsabilidad es aprovechar las oportunidades que me den. El año pasado hice 9 goles y 8 asistencias en un tiempo limitado. Son cuestiones del entrenador pero me tengo que adaptar a la situación y aprovechar las oportunidades" Ya adaptado: “Los primeros días me he sentido muy bien. Me encanta el estadio y las instalaciones arriba están muy bien. Me he encontrado un vestuario que es una familia y lo más importante es que hay auténticos jugadorazos y es un honor jugar con ellos. Hace nada los estaba viendo en la televisión y ahora son mis compañeros, estoy muy contento. Estoy directamente relacionado con Jones por nuestra historia común que somos los 2 de Marruecos pero me están ayudando todos a asentarme en el vestuario". Preparado para debutar: "Para mí estoy listo para jugar, me siento muy bien, siento que estoy en forma, que estoy fuerte. Evidentemente tengo que adaptarme a un nuevo estilo de juego pero estoy disponible y ya siento que a partir de hoy estoy totalmente preparado para jugar ya como titular pero es una decisión que está en las manos del entrenador y que decida lo que tenga que decidir".

articles.title: Lane Kiffin Addresses LSU Commitments, Roster Rules After SEC's Statement on Eligibility
articles.summary: LSU coach Lane Kiffin is keeping all of his options open as he and others await a resolution on the eligibility of a handful of players who signed with NFL teams this offseason.
articles.body:
LSU coach Lane Kiffin is keeping all of his options open as he and others await a resolution on the eligibility of a handful of players who signed with NFL teams this offseason.

Kiffin told ESPN's Pete Thamel he's in "daily communication" with SEC officials and that the rules allow the players in question to practice for the time being:

Last week, the SEC issued a statement saying it intended to prohibit athletes from returning to member schools from pro teams.

However, a Texas judge issued an order overruling the SEC's decision.

Kiffin is aiming to add at least three more players as the Tigers prepare for Saturday's opener against Clemson: tight end Dae'Quan Wright, defensive lineman Zxavian Harrison and edge-rusher Junior Tuihalamaka.

Former LSU edge-rusher Jack Pyburn reportedly had a return to Baton Rouge lined up in the event he got cut by the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. The Bucs officially let him go Sunday.

Ohio State coach Ryan Day probably summed up the thoughts of most college coaches when he said he doesn't like the idea of players coming back from the NFL. At the same time, he and others associated with the program have "gotta do what's right for Ohio State."

No coach wants to be left behind by the competition.

In the case of LSU, it's difficult enough to integrate in new players so close to the start of the season. Trey'Dez Green, a second-team All-SEC honoree, assumed all offseason he'd be the starting tight end, and now Wright could be serious competition for playing time.

The SEC, meanwhile, indicated the ongoing legal fight may not be over.

"The order entered against the SEC and commissioner Sankey is a temporary restraining order, not a final ruling on the merits," it said Sunday, per ESPN's Mark Schlabach . "The SEC and commissioner [Greg] Sankey are prepared to contest the allegations in the plaintiffs' petition at Thursday morning's hearing and defend the SEC's rights as a voluntary association to fulfill its mission to its member institutions."

The conference said it "will carefully review the court's decision and determine the appropriate next steps."

articles.title: Harvey Elliott to Valencia: Liverpool midfielder close to loan move
articles.summary: Valencia are in talks with Liverpool to take midfielder Harvey Elliott on loan for the rest of the season.

Valencia are in talks with Liverpool to take midfielder Harvey Elliott on loan for the rest of the season.

The 23-year-old spent last season on loan at Aston Villa but made only one Premier League start for them.

articles.body:
Conor Coady has left Wrexham following the mutual termination of his contract with the club.

The centre-back joined the Red Dragons on a permanent deal from Leicester City during the 2025 summer transfer window for an undisclosed fee, believed to be around £2m.

He recently entered the final year of his contract with the club - who held the option to extend his deal by an additional 12 months.

But it has been confirmed that Coady has departed the Racecourse Ground.

A club statement read: "All at Wrexham AFC would like to thank Conor for his efforts while with the club and wish him well for the future."

It comes as Wrexham are closing in on a deal to sign central defender Joe Worrall from Championship rivals Burnley.

Coady started Wrexham's opening five games of the 2025-26 campaign but swiftly fell down the pecking order in north Wales.

He joined Charlton Athletic on loan during the mid-season window and made 12 appearances for the Addicks.

Coady has not featured in any of Wrexham's four matchday squads across all competitions so far this season.

articles.title: Barcola completes £123m Liverpool move
articles.summary: Liverpool complete the signing of France forward Bradley Barcola from Paris St-Germain for a fee worth up to £123m.
articles.body:
Liverpool have completed the signing of France forward Bradley Barcola from Paris St-Germain for a fee worth up to £123m.

PSG initially valued the 23-year-old at £145m, but Liverpool will pay an initial £106m plus £17m in potential add-ons.

Barcola has signed a five-year contract to become the fifth new arrival at Anfield this summer, following the signings of winger Victor Munoz and defenders Jeremy Jacquet, Ronald Araujo and Ifeanyi Ndukwe.

"It took a long time but I'm really happy today to be able to play for Liverpool and all I want is to be on the pitch and be able to play," Barcola said.

"I hope to achieve very big things. First of all, winning the Premier League - it's one of my biggest dreams in my life.

"It is to do that and to stay in this team in the long term - that's why I signed a long contract – and I hope I can do it."

Barcola, who will wear the number 29 shirt at Anfield, prefers to play on the left wing but can operate across the forward line .

The France international will add depth to Andoni Iraola's squad following the departure of Mohamed Salah, the long-term injury absence of Hugo Ekitike, and the potential sale of Cody Gakpo.

Last season, Barcola scored 13 goals and provided seven assists in 49 games in all competitions for PSG.

He featured in all eight of France's games at the 2026 World Cup, scoring three goals as Les Bleus reached the third-place play-off.

Barcola joined PSG from Lyon in 2023 for a reported £38.5m and won three Ligue 1 titles, two Champions Leagues, the French Cup twice, the Uefa Super Cup and the Fifa Intercontinental Cup.

The fee Liverpool have agreed to pay includes covering a solidarity payment PSG owe Lyon as part of the deal that took Barcola to Paris three years ago.

Barcola - the 'grasshopper' who has overcome setbacks

Barcola is a left winger by trade, having played almost all of his Champions League minutes for PSG on that flank, but his game is shaped by a centre-forward's instincts. He played as a striker until the age of 17, something reflected in his movement and shot selection.

Last season, he averaged 3.5 shots per 90 minutes in Ligue 1, placing him among the division's most active shooters despite operating from wide areas.

His 9.83 expected goals (xG) ranked in the 95th percentile among wingers across Europe's top five leagues, meaning only around 5% of wide players consistently found themselves in better goalscoring positions.

Barcola converted those chances into 11 league goals, outperforming his xG, while no PSG player or Ligue 1 winger recorded a higher xG total during the 2025-26 campaign.

Those instincts are reflected in how he attacks defenders. Barcola was the only player across Europe's top five leagues to average more than two shot-ending carries per 90 minutes (2.06), illustrating his ability to drive at opponents before creating shooting opportunities for himself.

He also averaged 8.69 touches in the opposition penalty area per 90 minutes - the seventh-highest figure among more than 1,500 eligible players - reinforcing the profile of a winger who consistently occupies goalscoring positions.

His shot map highlights a player who attacks dangerous central areas rather than settling for speculative efforts from distance. Only Ousmane Dembele had a better combined shot volume with chance creation in Ligue 1, underlining Barcola's rare ability to both finish attacks and create opportunities for team-mates.

His work without the ball is another reason Liverpool 's recruitment team admired him. Barcola ranked ninth across Europe's top five leagues for possessions won in the final third last season, a metric that reflects the aggressive pressing and intensity demanded under Andoni Iraola.

articles.title: Liverpool sign Bradley Barcola from Paris Saint-Germain
articles.summary: Barcola’s move comes as Liverpool seek to reinforce their forward line after Mohamed Salah’s departure.
articles.body:
Liverpool have announced the signing of France international Bradley Barcola from Paris Saint-Germain.

The 23-year-old had been linked with a move to the Premier League club throughout the summer, and the Reds revealed the winger passed a medical on Monday before completing the deal.

It is understood that Barcola has signed a five-year deal in a package ⁠worth about 120 million pounds ($162m).

“It’s a great pride to be able to play for Liverpool. I’m very happy,” the Frenchman said on the Liverpool website.

“It took a long time, but I’m really happy today to be able to play for Liverpool, and all I want is to be on the pitch and be able to play.

“I hope to achieve very big things. First of all, winning the Premier League – it’s one of my biggest dreams in my life.

“It is to do that and to stay in this team in the long term – that’s why I signed a long contract – and I hope I can do it.”

Barcola was part of the French side that were beaten by eventual winners Spain in the semifinals of the FIFA World Cup 2026.

After starting his career with his hometown club, Olympique Lyonnais, Barcola moved to PSG in 2023 and was a big part of consecutive league and Champions League doubles.

The rise of Desire Doue with the French giants saw Barcola lose his regular starting place, however, leading to speculation that a transfer to another top European club could be possible.

Liverpool themselves had been searching for reinforcements in attack after the departure of Egypt international Mohamed Salah, who joined the Turkish club Trabzonspor in the summer transfer window.

Barcola has scored six goals in 28 international appearances for France, including scoring in the third-place playoff against England at the World Cup.

articles.title: Top 10 transfer portal impact players of Week 0
articles.summary: In the new era of college football, the transfer portal has become a significant component of roster construction. Throughout the 2026 college football seaso...
articles.body:
In the new era of college football, the transfer portal has become a significant component of roster construction. Throughout the 2026 college football season, On3 is breaking down the top 10 transfer portal impact players based on weekly performances. Here are the most impactful transfer portal players from Week 0:

Former Penn State and Missouri transfer Beau Pribula looked comfortable in his Virginia debut on Saturday. After a whirlwind experience in January trying to find his transfer destination — he made six visits before landing with the Cavaliers — he had one of the best games of his career against NC State. Pribula rushed for a career-best 110 yards and averaged 7.3 yards per carry. He completed 9 of 11 passes for 155 yards and two touchdowns, and he wasn't intercepted. Virginia cruised to a 34-8 win over the Wolfpack.

Davis Warren made his first start at Stanford on Saturday, marking his first college start since finishing the 2024 season at Michigan. He missed the 2025 season with a knee injury and won the Stanford starting job this summer after transferring in. Warren threw for 310 yards and a touchdown in the win over Hawaii, setting a career-high in passing yards. He engineered a game-winning drive, too, responding to Hawaii's three fourth-quarter touchdowns. Warren was 22 for 34 passing, including 5 for 5 for 58 yards on the game-winning drive.

A former four-star recruit, Jelani Thurman totaled just 144 receiving yards in three seasons at Ohio State. On Saturday in Dublin with North Carolina, Thurman emerged as the top target in the passing game for the Tar Heels. He finished with four catches for 94 yards, averaging 23.5 yards per catch. The 6-foot-6, 250-pound tight end was a problem for the TCU defense in the 15-10 win.

A former Florida commit, West Florida transfer Marcus Stokes made his FBS debut Saturday night in Las Vegas. Stokes beat out former Ohio State and South Carolina transfer Air Noland for the starting job in August. The Memphis quarterback was 15 of 26 for 223 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing for 45 yards. That included a 48-yard pass to open the second half and erasing a third-quarter deficit to win 27-21 over UNLV.

After only playing in eight games the last two seasons, Elijah Kinsler had his breakout game on Saturday. The former West Virginia and Southern Miss transfer posted eight tackles and 2.5 tackles for loss in the win over UNLV. He was a key piece of a six-sack night for the Tigers, holding UNLV to only 25 yards in the fourth quarter on Saturday night.

The former five-star recruit landed at UNLV this offseason after stops at Oklahoma and Auburn. Jackson Arnold had one of his best college games to date on Saturday night, accounting for three touchdowns. He completed 25 of 37 passes for 291 yards while also leading the Rebels with 54 rushing yards and a score. Arnold was sacked multiple times on the game's final drive, as UNLV couldn't put together a game-winning drive.

Another key piece of Charles Huff's new roster in Memphis, Jaylin Carter had a 36-yard touchdown run in the Tigers' win in Las Vegas on Saturday night. A former Southern Miss transfer, he carried the ball 15 times for 97 yards and averaged 6.5 yards per carry in the win.

After missing most of the 2025 season with an injury at Wisconsin, Billy Edwards hit the transfer portal in January and landed at North Carolina. A former Maryland transfer, Edwards was looking for a restart and found it in Chapel Hill with Bill Belichick. The quarterback was not perfect in Saturday's 15-10 win over TCU in Dublin, but he managed the game cleanly. He finished 16 of 28 for 232 yards passing.

Kent State transfer Da'Shawn Martin did not rack up catches in Saturday's win, but the one catch made a difference. He was on the receiving end of a 47-yard touchdown from Pribula, pushing the lead over the Wolfpack to three scores. He had 33 catches for 507 yards last season with the Golden Flashes.

The Hawaii transfer was solid in his San Jose State debut on Saturday afternoon in Los Angeles. Luke Weaver finished 21 of 32 for 234 yards and two touchdowns, finishing with a 65.6% completion percentage. USC won 42-26, but the Spartans tried to rally in the fourth quarter.

articles.title: Monday Cannon Fodder: Premier League MD2 Recap
articles.summary: Good morning, TSFers. Arsenal wrap up the MD2 action in the Premier League with a trip to Aston Villa to face our old “pal” Unai Emery and his new-look side....
articles.body:
Good morning, TSFers. Arsenal wrap up the MD2 action in the Premier League with a trip to Aston Villa to face our old "pal" Unai Emery and his new-look side. I don't care for this Monday match nonsense. The feeling of knowing how every other club did and knowing who Arsenal will lose ground to should they not win is not an enjoyable one. Folks, everyone (apart from Liverpool) that you'd care about how they've done won this weekend.

Crystal Palace 1 – Manchester City 4 Erling Haaland and Rayan Cherki both scored braces. A Donnarumma own goal briefly made the match 2-1. It was quickly 3-1 though, with a late goal to make it 4-1. Crystal Palace look as if they're going to be in a relegation battle this season, particularly if they lose Ismaila Sarr to Liverpool.

Coventry City 0 – Hull City 1 Just as we all predicted, the mighty Hull City Tigers, statistically one of the worst promoted teams in more than a decade, have started the season with 2 wins from 2. Coventry had nearly 70% possession, but an 82nd minute goal by Hull's Liam Millar claimed the points.

Bournemouth 1 – Everton 1 A 91st-minute James Tarkowski goal cancelled out Alex Scott's first half marker to split the points in what looks as if it will be Iliman Ndiaye's last match in an Everton shirt. He's heading to Spurs with Richarlison heading back to Everton in a totally distinct and separate transaction. The Toffees are going to hang onto coveted 19-year-old Harrison Armstrong, who'll be sold either this summer or next for an extremely large amount.

Spurs 0 – Newcastle 2 Second half goals from Anthony Elanga, who did the Thierry Henry slide after scoring and said as much, and Yoane Wissa sent Spurs to the bottom of the table with 0 goals scored and 5 conceded through two matches. Roberto de Zerbi complained after the match that you can't buy mentality on the transfer market. It's always someone else's fault with him.

Chelsea 4 – Brighton 3 A wild and weird match. Chelsea had 25% possession, completed fewer than 150 passes, generated 3.83 xG and scored 4 goals. Brighton probably should have considered showing up for the first half. They'd probably have been alright if they hadn't gone into halftime 3-1 down. Chelsea's attack looks potent, although I'd like to see how they manage both against better sides and against ones that will really commit to defending against them. Their defense looks suspect .

Leeds 1 – Brentford 1 Arsenal-linked Kevin Schade gave Brentford the lead before halftime, but Dominic Calvert-Lewin scored in the 79th minute to earn a draw for Leeds. Brentford will challenge for a Conference League place this season. Leeds should have enough to stay mostly out of the relegation battle.

Sunderland 1 – Fulham 0 The Black Cats got things back on track (for now) with a home win over the Cottagers courtesy of a 75th-minute Wilson Isidor goal. Sunderland are still on notice, particularly once the European matches start. The alarm bells are going off about Fulham.

Manchester United 5 – Ipswich Town 2 The scoreline flatters United, who went behind 1-0 in the 29th minute. Bruno Fernandes pulled one back before halftime. But the critical moment in the match came in the 56th minute with the scoreline at 1-1, when Harry Maguire clearly handled the ball before shooting and scoring. His shot took a heavy deflection off an unsuspecting Ipswich defender and went in. The goal stood because Maguire's shot was deemed to be off-target and so the unintentional deflection was ruled an own goal.

There's a fair bit to unpack here. First, the handball was ruled accidental, which is important. If Maguire had scored directly after an accidental handball, it wouldn't have stood. It's my understanding that if Maguire's shot had been on-target but had also taken a deflection, i.e. hadn't been ruled an own goal, it wouldn't have stood, either. But because the shot was off-target and it took an intervening deflection to make it an own goal, it stands.

What an asinine rule. Correctly applied by the letter of the Law. Incredibly dumb and counterintuitive. United ran away with things from there. Bruno scored a penalty in the 61st minute then completed the hat trick in the 68th. Bryan Mbeumo scored in the 82nd. Chuba Akpom scored a meaningless goal for Ipswich in the 91st.

articles.title: Bradley Barcola transfer news: Liverpool complete £123m signing of France winger from PSG
articles.summary: Bradley Barcola joins Liverpool for a fee potentially rising to £123m; France winger becomes club's second most expensive purchase behind £125m deal for Alexander Isak from Newcastle in 2025; Barcola follows Victor Munoz and Ronald Araujo into Anfield this summer
articles.body:
Barcola has agreed a five-year contract at Anfield. Liverpool will pay a guaranteed £106m for the winger, with add-ons potentially taking the fee to £123m.

"It's a great pride to be able to play for Liverpool. I'm very happy," the 23-year-old told Liverpoolfc.com.

"It took a long time but I'm really happy today to be able to play for Liverpool and all I want is to be on the pitch and be able to play.

"I hope to achieve very big things. First of all, winning the Premier League - it's one of my biggest dreams in my life. It is to do that and to stay in this team in the long term - that's why I signed a long contract - and I hope I can do it."

There had been a gap in valuation between the two clubs earlier in the summer, with PSG previously asking for around £145m for the France international, but Barcola has now become Andoni Iraola's third major signing of the summer after Victor Munoz and Ronald Araujo, with Jeremy Jacquet also arriving having been signed in January.

Barcola becomes Liverpool's second most expensive signing of all time, following the £125m deal for Alexander Isak from Newcastle last summer. He has been a long-term target and only wanted to move to Anfield.

In signing both Barcola and Munoz, Liverpool feel they have achieved their objective for the window of reinforcing in wide areas. They are unlikely to make any late additions unless there are outgoings.

Manchester City have been in contact with Liverpool over a move for Cody Gakpo.

Is Barcola really the right winger to replace Salah?

Analysis from Sky Sports News' Callum Bishop:

Liverpool appear to have made their decision that Bradley Barcola is their Mohamed Salah replacement. Even if they don't naturally play on the same flank, Barcola will surely be looked at as the man to bring Salah's level of productivity from wide areas.

When you think of Salah in his pomp, you think of the goals he brought to the team by cutting in from the right flank. Perhaps there's an expectation for the Frenchman to provide similar returns. But is that really what Liverpool need from their wingers?

Salah had his least productive season at Anfield last campaign. There are a number of factors behind why that is, but one of those was a change in his role thanks to the introduction of two number nines.

When the middle man in the Liverpool attack was Roberto Firmino, it allowed Salah to be the person chances were created for as the Brazilian was far from a stereotypical goalscorer. However, when Hugo Ekitike and Alexander Isak arrived on Merseyside, Salah's modus operandi shifted. More of a provider, less of a finisher.

His record of 10 assists wasn't terrible, but what's interesting is that he only provided one for Ekitike and none for Isak.

Barcola is an incredibly talented player with major upside, but Ekitike and Isak may see his arrival as more of a hindrance in their desire to shine.

One thing is for sure. Jamie Carragher isn't convinced that the France international is the answer Liverpool need.

"He's a left winger for me," Carragher said. "They don't have anyone who looks comfortable playing on the right but they have four players in the squad before Barcola joins who can play off the left.

"In terms of balance of the squad, it's not the position Liverpool need."

Ifeanyi Ndukwe - Austria Wien, undisclosed
